body:
Hi, SkyCarton is pleased to submit our quote for the RFQ-Q4 compostable mailer program. Our offer is USD 4.61 per unit at 120k MOQ with a 28-day lead time from artwork approval. We are currently in the process of renewing our ASTM D6400 certification and expect to have the updated report available within the next two weeks. Please note the higher MOQ threshold reflects our production line changeover schedule for Q4.

Let us know if you need any additional details in the meantime.

Best regards,
Kevin Liu
SkyCarton Sales
